Substrate as a native KDE Plasma 6 wallpaper: growing cracks with sand, sparks, rainbow lines and explosions.

**Downloads**

- `Substrate-<version>-linux-x86_64.zip`: the finished wallpaper package (x86_64, Plasma 6, Qt 6.5 or newer, glibc 2.35 or newer).
  Install it with `kpackagetool6 -t Plasma/Wallpaper -i <file>` and restart Plasma
  (`systemctl --user restart plasma-plasmashell`).
- **Source code (zip)**, added by GitHub: unpack and run `./install.sh` (needs cmake, a C++ compiler and the Qt 6
  development packages). Use this on any other system, or if the package does not load.

See the [README](https://github.com/Spider19996/Substrate-KDE-Wallpaper#readme) for the settings, the theme manager and
the theme file format.
